title: Full mouth oral rehabilitation of a severely worn dentition based on a fully digital workflow
authors: Lanis A, Gallucci G, Pedrinaci I. J Esthet Restor Dent. 2023;35(4):596-608. doi:10.1111/jerd.13020
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxgraft granules (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “An appropriate knowledge on dental erosion and oral rehabilitation, combined with a digital dentistry approach could lead the clinician to deliver a fast, accurate and predictable noninvasive restorative treatment in cases like the one described” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
